title: AdminDecideResponse
description: Exact 200 body of POST /api/egress/decide from _handle_egress_decide_post in src/admin_daemon.py. The admin daemon transforms the broker's /decide response into this shape for the browser.

ok.$comment: The proxy always sets ok: true on a 200.

decided.$comment: Count of request ids decided by this action.

reason.$comment: Reasons the admin proxy forwards from the broker's apply_failures.
